phoneme_focus: -ing/-ed participle rhythm; pausing at the participle-clause boundary

grammar_point.title: Participle clauses (present, past, perfect)
grammar_point.en: Reduce clauses to participles for concise, formal style: Having finished…, Seen from above…, Being aware….
grammar_point.ar: اختصار الجُمَل إلى مشتقّات لأسلوب موجز ورسمي.

vocabulary.example: Having considered the options, we chose the first.
Being aware of the risk, she proceeded carefully.
Given the data, the choice is clear.
Keep the report concise.
Participle clauses streamline your writing.
Condense two clauses into one.
The line was cut; consequently, we lost data.
It cuts costs, thereby raising margins.
Prices fell, thus boosting demand.
Having assessed the risk, we acted.
Evaluating the results, we found gaps.
Having concluded the study, they published.
The plan, once implemented, worked.
Acknowledging the flaw, they apologised.
Faced with a crisis, they stayed calm.
Based on the findings, we recommend...
Compared with last year, sales rose.
A speech, followed by questions, ended the day.
The report, accompanied by data, convinced them.
Designed to save time, it succeeded.
The measures, intended to help, backfired.
Prompted by complaints, they acted.
Regarding the budget, we agree.
Weighing the pros and cons, we decided.
Taking into account the cost, it's fair.
In light of recent events, we paused.
We simplified it so as to save time.
With a view to expanding, they hired more.
Having said that, risks remain.
Notwithstanding the delay, it succeeded.
The underlying cause was ignored.

Saturday.prompt: Use 'Having + past participle, …' for three sequenced actions.

Sunday.prompt: Join ideas with present participles ('Realising…, she…').

Tuesday.prompt: Explain a decision formally: 'Given…', 'Faced with…', 'Taking into account…'.

Wednesday.prompt: Describe a process concisely using participle clauses.

Thursday.prompt: Summarise a report to a partner using participle clauses for concision.

Friday.prompt: Deliver a concise analysis (10-12 sentences) rich in participle clauses.

writing_prompts: Join three pairs of ideas using present participle clauses.
Write two result clauses with thereby/thus.
Explain a decision formally with 'Given…' / 'Faced with…'.
Rewrite three two-clause sentences using participle clauses.
Describe a process concisely with participle clauses.
Write a formal paragraph using several participle clauses for concision.
